pending_commit.commit_message: bsdrm: add pipe plumber class for making pipes with constraints The bs_drm_pipe_plumber class is like an expanded version of bs_drm_pipe_make. By default, it will check every card and open it on behalf of the user. It also supports more constraints, and makes adding more with later version of this library very easy without breaking existing code. Currently, it supports limiting which connectors, crtcs, and drm cards are used for making a pipe. The connectors can even be ranked to support fall back connectors. Another advantage is that the pipe plumber can be used to collect the drmModeConnector that was already gotten during the pipe making process. It's purely an optimization, but saves 1 second per drmModeGetConnector call in the case that an external connector is used. This change also includes a related module used for ranking connectors. It includes some standard rankings that most apps should use. The stripe example was changed to use this new class to show how it works. The main motivation for these changes was the gamma_test which will need both the crtc masking and connector ranking. It was also used to integrate the drm_open and drm_pipe functions which were starting to have serious overlap. It no longer makes sense to keep them separate, but this CL won't remove the drm_open module for now. drm-tests: refactor gamma_test to use bsdrm The gamma_test in particular exercised the advanced features of bsdrm because it supports external connectors and CRTC masks. Using bsdrm has made the test focus much more on what matters to it, generating and testing gamma tables on CRTCs. This test also used the "sp" library whose functionality can be fulfilled better by gbm for making buffers and bsdrm for the mmaping and display. This CL removes the dependency on "sp" for gamma_test. CHROMIUM: mali: register suspend notifier to runtime resume This adds a pm notifier for mali to runtime resume the gpu device on suspend prepare. Genpd will just leave the gpu device runtime suspended on system suspend, but that causes issues for mali. This works around that by making sure the mali gpu device is runtime resumed on system suspend before the genpd prepare callback is called. CR50: add support for RSA key "testing" Implement _cpri__TestKeyRSA, which computes the modulus and private exponent given a pair of primes, or computes the second prime and private exponent given the modulus and one prime. The _cpri__TestKeyRSA call is used to determine whether the components of an RSA key match each other. Autotest: Add specified exception type to Retry for dev_server and servo After adding ssh feature to dev_server and servo, we need to do retry when meeting error.CmdError (ssh error). However a specified error type needs to raised after retry, in order to be caught by its caller. For example, a caller needs to call dev_server.get_control_file(). The ideal case is we retry ssh connections to dev_server if it fails. When retry is finished, we need it to raise a DevServerException, which is currently caught by the caller. This CL adds a specified exception to raise in retry, and also refactors the error msg raising processes. BUG=chromium:598496 TEST=Checked dev_server and servo raise the corresponding error types in local autotest instance. Ran dev_server_unittest. frecon: keep on trying opening DRM device until frecon has master display_boot_message script kills existing instance of frecon, which should allow a new instance of frecon to get DRM master for DRM file it opens. Except, somehow drm_release associated with the old instance of frecon gets delayed in kernel for few seconds and the new frecon does not get master. This CL adds a loop in frecon that will keep opening the device until it has master. BUG=chromium:589122 TEST=boot Chrome OS in normal mode.
